newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia tin falls on currency, poor demand.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia tin falls on currency, poor demand.

text.p: Malaysia's spot tin price fell nine cents to finish at 13.81 ringgit ($5.30) a kg after the ringgit rebounded sharply against the U.S. dollar and on poor overseas demand, traders said.
They saw an opening bid of 21 tonnes against offer of 127 tonnes. Final turnover was 65 tonnes against 135 on Monday, with buying mainly from Europe, Japan and Malaysia.
"The market was helped by the ringgit's rise and ignored the gains in London," a trader said. The local premium over London was at $20 a tonne against a discount of $5 on Monday.
